summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit announcing that Houdini Swap, its wholly-owned privacy-focused cross-chain swap aggregator, is now integrated into Jumper, a multi-chain aggregation app. This is a product integration announcement, not a special situation corporate event. There are no pricing terms, stakes, premiums, board recommendations, or structural mechanics applicable. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer under cover of Form 6-K, disclosing a commercial partnership and technology deployment.
